in_marathi.name: Rishiveda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge and Learning
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rishiveda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rishiveda is a Sanskrit name derived from Rishi, meaning sage, and Veda, meaning knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Rishiveda is the goddess of knowledge and learning, revered by scholars and students alike for her wisdom and grace.
